extension.summary: Calm skin with a glowing ember accent and colour themes
extension.description: The Nightcity skin in a quiet look: near-black, a glowing ember focus, colour themes, rounded buttons and big artwork, with online movie and TV data from TMDb Helper.
extension.news: 0.1.1 - A new look for Home: the tabs in the middle, the spotlight as a large sharp picture, continue and next up as wide cards with the art of the film or show, posters in every other row.[CR]A logo of its own, also as the icon, and a quiet loading page with the logo and a spinner.[CR]The fades over the spotlight and the player controls are lighter, a focused card glows, and the glow of a focused tab is no longer cut off.[CR]The subtitle and audio delay can be set again in the player.[CR]0.1.0 - First version of Confuse: the Nightcity skin in a calm look with a glowing ember focus and colour themes.
